source_text: Tertiam prophetiam Balaam tractamus. Balac putat locum defuisse maledictioni; ducit eum in verticem Phogor.
pass_a_gloss: Third prophecy of-Balaam we-treat. Balak thinks place to-have-lacked for-curse; he-leads him onto peak of-Peor.
pass_b_english: We treat Balaam’s [[third prophecy >> Bible:Numbers 23:25—24:9]]. Balak thinks only the place failed the curse and leads him to [[the summit of Peor >> Bible:Numbers 23:28]].
